title: Valtux 1.2
content: Valtux OS is a desktop Linux distribution based on Debian's "Stable" branch and featuring the KDE Plasma desktop. Developed in Switzerland, it provides out-of-the-box support for all official languages (French, German, Italian and Romansh) and keyboard layouts used in the country. The distribution includes many popular productivity and multimedia software and is intended for all types of users - from complete Linux beginners to experienced power users.
